final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS avg_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_rate, step1.site_count, step1.avg_rate - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.avg_rate > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(site_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
